title: Quorum Sensing: Autoinducers and Population-Dependent Responses
count_method: Unicode lexical count from final saved p.teaching-prose text excluding headings, figures, tables, questions, references, revision and reader UI. Visible article count includes expandable answers and visible SVG text but excludes SVG title/desc and buttons.

comparator.method: Fetched published HTML at 8f7bcb45811d275bde044b710733ef0f0c187beb and counted teaching prose using the same lexical regex (entity treatment may differ slightly from its own QA). Also inspected 3.C.14 reader and narrative.

scientific_checks: Verified official merged CSIR-UGC-DBT Unit 4.A printed p.5 and separate CSIR NET Unit 4.B p.3; archived MP SET 2024 Unit 4.B p.3 visually checked.

Mapped every 4.A.13 roadmap requirement: signal production, release, accumulation and thresholds; LuxI–LuxR and bioluminescence; peptide sensing and agr; AI-2 with receptor diversity; organism-specific outputs; distinction from chemotaxis and non-population two-component inputs.

Reviewed signal balance with fixed and growing density, effective removal, receptor occupancy vs reporter response, Hill model, feedback equilibria, reporter delay, normalization, diffusion estimate, and limitations.

Checked LuxI precursor chemistry, AHL connectivity and transport, LuxR promoter/feedback, luciferase and LuxG, AgrD/AgrB/AgrC/AgrA/P2/P3, LuxS/Pfs/DPD and LuxP/LsrB structural findings, LuxPQ sign and distinct V. harveyi LuxR, Lsr uptake and metabolic confounding.

Landmark paper records and accessible text checked for 1970 luminescence, 1981 AHL chemistry, 1983/1984 genetics, 1996 purified LuxI, 2002/2004 AI-2 structure, and signal quenching/agr dispersal. Hypothetical examples distinguished from actual evidence.

Second review replaced 15 distractors, strengthened historical biochemical and structural evidence and flavin energetics, added three verified references and reviewed SVG coordinates, graph axes and feedback annotation.

academic_self_review.method: Internal second-pass review, not external peer review. Scope: roadmap responsibilities and boundaries all developed. Accuracy: named-system qualifications and equations reviewed, but not all primary full texts read. Depth: 144 substantive distinct paragraphs, comparative and mechanism-based progression with no observed essential gap. Evidence/quantitative: 30 arithmetic checks; historical experimental context partly constrained by source access. Practice: 52 explained items with reviewed distractors, but not independently examiner-calibrated. Technical: static saved source and coordinate/label checks pass; interactive mobile/browser and full accessibility testing not performed.

limitations: Available peer-reviewed records, accessible abstracts/text and OpenStax sections reviewed; no claim that every primary paper or named textbook edition was fully read.
